data.change_summary: Unified shrimp feeding-stage weights behind a single source of truth by promoting the biology-layer constants to shared crate-visible constants and importing them into `systems/shrimp.rs`, eliminating the 0.65 vs 0.67 sub-adult divergence between public `AnimalState` helpers and the simulation. I also corrected the stale trim tests so closed-system helper coverage now uses `TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings` with the current budget label, while the plant/algae integration detritus-routing test now exercises the leave-cuttings variant that actually sends trimmed biomass to fine detritus. After formatting, the amended tests and the full `tank_core` suite pass.

steps.description: Inspected the feeding-weight definitions and trim-related tests, then reproduced the two failing trim regressions to confirm the required fixes.

Reworked `crates/tank_core/src/types/biology.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/mod.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs` so shrimp feeding weights come from one shared constant set used by both public biology helpers and runtime simulation logic.
Updated `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs` so the closed-system helper assertion covers `TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings` with the current `action:trim_plants_and_leave_cuttings` budget label.
Updated `crates/tank_core/tests/plant_algae_integration.rs` so the detritus-routing scenario uses `TrimPlantsAndLeaveCuttings`, matching the engine's export-vs-cuttings semantics.
Ran formatting plus targeted validation and then the full `tank_core` test suite to confirm the amendments and surrounding behavior remain green.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core` passed (full package suite, including save/load migration coverage and trim/export regressions).
